analysis.investment_thesis: Shipwaves looks optically cheap at 5.4x P/E with stellar ROE of 56% and ROCE of 35%, riding the digital freight-forwarding and logistics SaaS tailwind in India. But at a ₹49 Cr market cap with a 2015-vintage promoter and no track record of scaling, this is a micro-cap speculation rather than a conviction India growth bet.
key_strengths: Exceptional capital efficiency: ROE 56.1%, ROCE 35.4% — rare for a logistics player
Low valuation at 5.4x P/E with promoter holding a healthy 67.36%
Operates in a structurally growing segment — digital freight + enterprise SaaS
key_risks: Micro-cap (₹49 Cr) — liquidity, governance and disclosure risks are elevated
Freight forwarding is asset-light but brutally competitive with thin moats
Optical ROE on a tiny equity base may not sustain as the company scales
red_flags: Recently listed SME-style BSE scrip with limited operating history as a public company
Share price of ₹4.37 suggests possible penny-stock volatility and promoter-driven price action
analysis.detailed_analysis: Bhai, the numbers look beautiful on paper — ROE of 56% and ROCE of 35% at just 5.4x earnings is the kind of screen hit I would normally investigate hard. Digital freight forwarding is a genuine India theme: export-import volumes are rising, MSMEs are digitizing shipping, and logistics is a trillion-rupee market where SaaS-based players can take share from traditional forwarders. Promoter holding at 67.36% is comforting — they have skin in the game.\n\nBut conviction requires more than ratios. A ₹49 Cr market cap with a ₹4 share price is the deep end of micro-caps where governance, related-party transactions, and earnings quality need verification before any position. Freight forwarding margins are notoriously fragile and dependent on ocean/air freight cycles, and "SaaS" claims at this scale often mean a few enterprise contracts rather than a product moat. I would want to see 2–3 years of audited public-company filings, promoter pedigree, client concentration, and working-capital discipline before sizing this. Interesting watchlist candidate — not a buy today.
